title: Tenma Saki — Sports Festival Committee!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: A few days after the Sports Festival
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe... Teehee...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Saki... Are you still looking at Sports Festival pictures?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I took heaps and slowly sorting them into albums on my phone...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can't bring myself to deleting any of them, so I'm still stuck with this mountain of photos.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. You might be at it for some time then.
It goes to show you really enjoyed that day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sigh... And it's hard to believe that it's already been a week since then...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You were so busy with the committee too.
I'm glad everything went well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And you were super worried about my health during the lead-up to sports day too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, how...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It was all over your face!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm way stronger now compared to when I caught that cold last time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. You helped organize the whole event and even took part in it yourself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right? I had to make sure it was gonna be the best sports day ever!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I couldn't have done it without Haruka and Emu!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, they put in a lot of effort into it too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup. But that wasn't all they just did!
Sometime before the Sports Festival

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heeey! Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Otori. How did practice go for the three-legged race?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, um... Yeah, it was good!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh... Haruka. Emu.
Are you staying back today too?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. There's something I should get done before I leave.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you stayed so late yesterday too. I feel bad for not realizing it'd end up being so much work.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, you don't need to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But... I invited you to join the committee after saying it wouldn't take up that much time, and it turns out I couldn't have been more wrong.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You invited me, but it was my own decision to help Emu put her grand ideas into practice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Besides, if I hadn't joined the committee, I'd never have found out how satisfying it can be to organize the event instead of only participating in it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (She really seems to be enjoying this work.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I really should do more too...
But...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Uh, no... Well, I'd like your opinion on something...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our opinion?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You see... A while ago, I tried to organize an event for Ichi and my old friends. It was supposed to be a trip to the observatory...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But between school, band practice and my part-time job, I ended up overdoing it and got caught a cold...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I didn't understand my own limits very well back then. I could do it all in my mind, but not physically.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This may sound crazy coming from me but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Along with organizing it, I want to compete in some Sports Festival events too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But that might make things harder for you two, and you might have to pick up my slack...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... I really need your help with this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You... Need my help?
Haruka! We're helping someone!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Haha, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't worry about it, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You don't have to take on more work than what you're comfortable with, and you can count on us for the rest.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪ It'd be a shame if you didn't get to be in any events after working so hard to make it all happen!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I want everyone to have fun!
Including you, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay... Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but feel free to ask me for help too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll do everything that I can!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know first-hand how easy it is to push yourself too hard too, so go at your own pace and remember that we're all in this together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, that was very nice of them.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Huh. You really like penguins that much, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I just love how adorably round they are.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Have you noticed that more people have been going up to Haruka to talk with her?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. They used to treat her a bit like a guest or something before, but I guess that's changed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have to think the Sports Festival has a lot to do with that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You inviting her to join the committee and having to engage with a lot of students helped break the ice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. So does that mean I was able to help her out too?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I certainly think so.
